verdict.rationale: Codex cloud tasks can be started from the web or the CLI. They can then be browsed from the terminal, given follow-up requests, and applied to a local repository, so cloud-delegated work can move between surfaces. However, `codex resume` only searches local chats, so local CLI sessions are not shown to continue on another device. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-device session sync, continuation of local CLI or IDE sessions on another machine, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser

citations.quote: Start and review work from the web or Codex CLI.
Browse active and completed chats, submit work to a configured environment, and apply the result to your local repository from the terminal.
Inspect the summary and diff, request a follow-up, or open a pull request when the result is ready.
Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready.
